description:
Helm sets off on an adventure in Blue Water Island.
Although she looks strange wearing a uniform over the swimsuit that was given to her, people can't help but be attracted to her getup.

lines.text: Eeep! So cold!
If you keep splashing water around like that, there's no point in me wearing anything...
Subordinate, I'd kindly ask you to quit splashing me with water.
If you keep splashing me like that, you'll be able to see through my... er...
This is my first time wearing this kind of swimsuit, so I'm a bit self-conscious.
*Gasp* Subordinate, are you doing this on purpose?
If there's nothing to be done, can I go for a swim in the ocean?
You can head back if you want. I'm going to stay and look at the ocean.
When do you think we'll be able to come back to the ocean again?
I don't know when, if ever, I'll be back here, so I'm going to make the most of it.
Have you seen Anchor or Mast? I feel they've been lax in their duties ever since we got back from the beach.
How about we take a nice walk on the beach together?
I think it's finally time to show my skills.
I won't disappoint you.
I get to be a part of a real battle? I've got no problem with that.
I feel bad. You always give me gifts, but I never reciprocate. Is there anything you want?

You've already given me so much,
yet you're still giving me more?
I can use this to help maintain the Admire... Oh, never mind.
To me, you're just like the ocean. Every time I see you, I feel rejuvenated... and I always want to see you.
The water is freezing, so why are my cheeks so hot?
Today has been a dream come true. I will never forget it as long as I live.
I'll do whatever I can to help.
Awaiting your orders, Subordinate.
Coordinates have been confirmed.
Rapture discovered, ready for battle.
Aegis Squad, preparations complete.
Let's give it our all.
Anchor, Mast, let's go!
Faster...!
Reloading, all good.
Cover me.
Admire, setting coordinates.
Aegis cannon! Full steam ahead! Open fire!
Front ports open! Fire away!
Clear!
One down.
Still more to go!
Ack!
It's okay...
Gah...!
I didn't train enough... I'm sorry.
This is where I belong.
